title: Partition a set into two subsets with minimum absolute sum difference
statementHtml: Given an array arr of n integers, partition the array into two subsets such that the absolute difference between their sums is minimized.
examples:
Input: arr = [1, 7, 14, 5]

Output: 1

Explanation: The array can be partitioned as [1, 7, 5] and [14], with an absolute difference of 1.

Input: arr = [3, 1, 6, 2, 2]

Output: 0

Explanation: The array can be partitioned as [3, 2, 2] and [6, 1], with an absolute difference of 0.
constraintsHtml:
• 1 ≤ n * sum of array elements ≤ 106
  • 0 < arr[i] <= 104
